action_library: All 2187 partial binary assignments, including the empty conjunction and full seven-field answers. For each of 128 subsets select its highest-probability assignment, then choose subset by expected stipulated loss.
analysis: Average two fits inside each of eight worlds, 4096 whole-world paired bootstrap draws. Each reader native-to-shift change; naive Bayes and current duplicate-removal retained. Fresh-law remains the extra-label diagnostic. No fit/case independence.
comparison: Identical action library and ratios for every reader; report adaptive loss, true versus expected error, coverage, retained alternatives, and a fixed-cardinality frontier for all 0..7 fields. Fixed specificity means equal number of fields, not identical fields or coverage.
continuation: Retain only an observed loss/specificity tradeoff that beats the matched direct policy; do not promote a gain consisting solely of less coverage. Other registered conditional branches remain open subject to measured resources.
limits: Post-selection development on existing candidates; no new corroborating population.
Unknown loss preferences in any real product; no human interpretation.
Inherited oracle support, fitting-capacity and validation convergence limitations.
No widening of confirmation or changes to prior criteria.
loss: (7 - asserted fields)/7 + ratio * indicator(any asserted field is wrong). Abstaining on all fields costs one; a false full answer costs ratio. These are declared decision costs, not the original proper probability scores.
preacceptance: Immutable upstream COMPLETE and every used raw hash
Independent scalar all-subset probabilities, chosen actions and every saved policy score
Full frozen-source artifact-native scientific replay, with all six originals complete first
Fixed-cardinality error comparisons prevent fewer assertions from masquerading as better reconstruction
question: Does honest partial answering reduce observed loss beyond withholding more information, compared at equal specificity?
selection: All three selected-development candidates and their paired execution counterparts; fixed unchanged forecasts from eight original readers. No refitting, no new discovery worlds, no confirmation.
tie_rule: Lowest integer mask and assignment within 1e-12 at each cardinality; fewer asserted fields within 1e-12 expected-loss tie.
